propositions: Canonical contributor guidance in AGENTS.md and .agents/rules/rebar.md hardcodes a specific bot identity (Joe Oakhart) instead of directing contributors to use their own configured git identity
CONTRIBUTING.md requires real contributor names for DCO sign-off, conflicting with agent guidance that prescribes a specific third-party bot identity
No deterministic lint check exists to prevent reintroduction of hardcoded personal identities in contributor-facing documentation
Contributor-facing documentation (AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/*.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/**/*.md) must be made consistent in describing identity-neutral DCO practices
Automation-scoped paths (infra/, .github/workflows/, tests/fixtures/, docs/experiments/) legitimately reference the bot identity and must be excluded from the consistency sweep
